commands.purpose: Verify W4-016 checklist items C01-C07 on PCA affine-tail domain
Fit PCA on train split and validate affine domain & outer box on validation split

requirement_evidence.notes: Defined tail = c + B diag(a) u + diag(e) v with orthonormal basis B (384, K), singular values, and non-negative residual bounds.
Fit strictly on 9,944 train-split consecutive pairs; zero contamination from validation or test splits; hash pinned.
Implemented immutable domain class with read-only properties, shape checks, and deterministic domain_id hashing.
Enforces prefix match, latent feasibility |u*| <= a, and orthogonal residual bounds |r| <= e with float32 rounding guard.
Derived outer bounding box relaxation via Cauchy-Schwarz sum |B| a + e; verified containment of all affine members.
Verified that omitting residual bounds (e=0) fails points outside the principal subspace; tested centering and step mismatches.
Generated domain_fit.json (fit_sha256=d11da4200e) and affine_domain_validation.json on 50 validation pairs.

scientific_dispositions.evidence: PCA basis captures temporal and cross-channel sensor correlations; outer box expansion explicitly measures the volume hull loss.
Affine domain enforces dual constraints (latent subspace and bounded orthogonal residual), avoiding unconstrained volume growth.
Affine domain candidate is valid strictly for step t+1 and rejects sequence gaps or recording resets fail-closed.

limitations: Affine domain membership solver uses orthogonal projection and coordinate-wise residual bounds; higher-order ellipsoid relaxations require custom quadratic programming not supported on CPU streaming deadlines.
